relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine (Journavx) is a first-in-class, oral, non-opioid analgesic that selectively inhibits the voltage-gated sodium channel 1.8 (NaV1.8)

key_findings: Protocol for a single-arm feasibility study of suzetrigine in outpatient facial plastic surgery; no results reported.
